build_encoder_with_vit_backbone: build a pretrained ViT encoder and scratch layers using _make_encoder with backbone vitb16_384
create_scratch_adapter_layers: create scratch Conv2d adapter layers from backbone feature shapes using _make_scratch
build_efficientnet_backbone: build an EfficientNet-Lite3 pretrained backbone for feature extraction using _make_pretrained_efficientnet_lite3
create_residual_conv_unit: create a ResidualConvUnit module with two 3x3 convolutions and a skip connection
build_feature_fusion_block: build a FeatureFusionBlock_custom that fuses multi-scale features with residual units and bilinear upsampling
